description: Retrieves time series data for an organization's Sentry project release health sessions; note session duration data (e.g., using `avg(session.duration)`) may be incomplete after Jan 12, 2023, results are capped at 10,000 data points, `statsPeriod` overrides `start`/`end` timestamps, and the `interval` parameter (default/min '1h', max '1d', format like `statsPeriod`) dictates time series resolution and must cleanly divide one day.

end.description: End of the query period (ISO-8601 format). Ignored if `statsPeriod` is provided.
end.title: End

environment.description: Environment names to filter sessions by (e.g., 'production', 'staging').
environment.title: Environment

field.description: Fields for session statistics (e.g., `sum(session)`, `count_unique(user)`, `p99(session.duration)`, `crash_free_rate(user)`). Session duration aggregations may be incomplete for data after Jan 12, 2023.
field.title: Field

groupBy.description: Properties to group session data by (e.g., `project`, `release`, `environment`, `session.status`).
groupBy.title: Group By

includeSeries.description: Set to `0` to exclude, `1` (API default) to include time series data.
includeSeries.title: Include Series

includeTotals.description: Set to `0` to exclude, `1` (API default) to include totals.
includeTotals.title: Include Totals

interval.description: Time series data resolution (e.g., '1h', '1d'; format like `statsPeriod`). Minimum '1h', maximum '1d'. Must cleanly divide one day.
interval.title: Interval

orderBy.description: Field from `field` parameter to order results by. Prefix with '-' for descending (e.g., `-sum(session)`).
orderBy.title: Order By

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique ID or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

per_page.description: Maximum number of groups (aggregated data points based on `groupBy`) per request.
per_page.title: Per Page

project.description: Project IDs to filter sessions by. Use `[-1]` for all accessible projects.
project.title: Project

query.description: Sentry search query to filter sessions (e.g., `(transaction:foo AND release:abc)`). See Sentry docs for syntax.
query.title: Query

start.description: Start of the query period (ISO-8601 format). Ignored if `statsPeriod` is provided.
start.title: Start

statsPeriod.description: Relative query period (e.g., '24h', '7d'), overrides `start` and `end`. Uses 'd' (days), 'h' (hours), 'm' (minutes), 's' (seconds), or 'w' (weeks).
statsPeriod.title: Stats Period

name: get_organization_sessions

end.description: The end date/time of the data range in ISO 8601 format.
end.title: End

groups.description: Array of grouped session statistics. Each group contains aggregated data based on the specified groupBy dimensions (project, release, environment, session.status).
groups.title: Groups

intervals.description: Array of timestamp intervals for the time series data matching the requested resolution.
intervals.title: Intervals

query.description: The query filter applied to the results.
query.title: Query

start.description: The start date/time of the data range in ISO 8601 format.
start.title: Start

SessionGroup.description: Grouped session statistics with aggregated data.

by.description: Grouping dimensions for the data. Common properties include 'project' (integer), 'release' (string), 'environment' (string), or 'session.status' (string with values: 'healthy', 'errored', 'crashed', 'abnormal').
by.title: By

series.description: Time series data with metric values as arrays of numbers corresponding to the intervals. Common metrics include 'sum(session)' arrays. Can be excluded by setting includeSeries=0 in the request.
series.title: Series

totals.description: Aggregated totals for the metrics across the entire time period. Common metrics include 'sum(session)' for total session count. Can be excluded by setting includeTotals=0 in the request.
totals.title: Totals

SessionGroup.title: SessionGroup
